overrideHooks.basis: s4fapi: 1.20.4's ItemStack.isSuitableFor(state) asked FabricItem.isSuitableFor(stack, state), whose default asked the item's isSuitableFor(state): in a class declaring both, the Fabric method answers 1.20.5's isCorrectForDrops(stack, state) and reaches the vanilla one through its super call (CbFapiItems.superIsSuitableFor)

_s4fapi_networking_basis: Fabric API 1.20.5 replaced 1.20.4's channel networking (an Identifier plus a raw PacketByteBuf, and FabricPacket/PacketType on top of it) with CustomPayload types registered per phase and direction in PayloadTypeRegistry. compat/fapi gives 1.20.4's API back: a channel is a CbChannelPayload type of its id (impl/networking/CbChannels; registered for the receiving side when a 1.20.4 receiver is registered, the send side written through CbPayloads' fallback where nothing registered it), 1.20.4 handlers are wrapped as 1.20.5 handlers, PacketSender's dropped members dispatch to a mod's own 1.20.4 implementation (CbLegacyPacketSender) or build channel payloads for 1.20.5's senders, and a GenericFutureListener reaches its write's channel future again (CbFapiFutureListenerMixin).
_s4fapi_depRenames_basis: 1.20.5's Fabric API (0.97.8) no longer ships fabric-containers-v0 and fabric-events-lifecycle-v0, which 1.20.4's (0.97.3) did (META-INF/jars of both fabric-api jars, core/tools/fapi_modules.py); this step's layer gives their APIs back (compat/fapi container + client/screen, event/{client,server,world}, with their entrypoints' work in CbFapiInit / CbFapiClientInit), so a mod's dependency on them is met by the layer
_s4fapi_loot_basis: Fabric API 1.20.5 kept LootTableEvents and its three fields but changed every listener's shape (a registry key, no resource or loot manager), so a 1.20.4 listener cannot be registered on them (the event's array is typed by the new interface). A 1.20.4 mod's listener types are compat/fapi/loot/v2/LootTableEvents' (1.20.4 shapes, s4item's facade/LootDataManager for the loot manager), its reads of the three fields reach those events, and impl/loot/CbLootEvents fires them as 1.20.4 did once all loot data of a reload is read (CbFapiLootEventsMixin at ReloadableRegistries.apply, before vanilla freezes the registries)

overrideRenames.basis: s4fapi: 1.20.5's FabricItem renamed allowNbtUpdateAnimation, same arguments and meaning (components are 1.20.5's NBT)

s4fapi: 1.20.5's RecipeProvider.run(writer) is final (waits for the registries, then run(writer, registries)); a 1.20.4 subclass's override (vanilla's, FabricRecipeProvider's or its own) is renamed and CbRecipeRunMixin hands the final run to it; its super.run(writer) reaches the final body inside the guard
